text:
lee: Quick check-in for GA readiness  Specifically want to lock SLA targets, monitoring dashboards, escalation playbook, and support tier handoffs. Can owners volunteer?

tara: I can take SLA targets + runbook language. Want to propose a 99.95% monthly availability SLO for hosted API and a 100ms p50 / 250ms p95 target for single-request gen on standard models. Thoughts?

michael: Those numbers look reasonable. I'd like to add separate latency buckets for streaming responses (p95 < 500ms for first-chunk) and bulk-batch jobs (throughput > X tok/s). Also include a soft SLO for embeddings endpoints.

lee: Good call. Keep streaming and batch separate. Tara, can you also draft a customer-facing "what we guarantee" snippet and internal incident severity levels tied to SLA breaches?

tara: Yep. Draft will map severity 1=service down (page), severity 2=degradation impacting >20% of requests (page + notify CS), severity 3=partial degradation (ticket + DM).

eng-oncall-bot: alert created: api_error_rate > 0.005 for 10m -> page oncall.

bella-cs: From CS perspective, add an escalation step: if customer impacted is Enterprise with Dedicated, route to account-eng and add Senior SE to the thread within 30 minutes. Also we need a canned email template. I can write that.

michael: Monitoring owners: infra-metrics will own uptime/latency dashboards, app-metrics will own request-level tracing and quota breach metrics, billing-metrics will own billing event counts and invoice replay status.

lee: We need guardrails for rollback. Propose: automatic rollback if canary error_rate > 1% sustained 5m OR if billing mismatch > 2% across top 10 accounts after replay. Also disable automated invoice emails until manual approval.

finance-bot: note: finance requires invoice preview with line items and discounts for manual sign-off before any production customer email. Audit logs must be retained 90 days.

tara: For monitoring, I'll add these dashboard panels to the GA kit: overall availability, p50/p95/p99 latency by route, quota enforcement rate, billing_event_success_rate, invoice_replay_queue_depth, and top-20 customer cost delta.

michael: Also add an anomaly detector on token consumption spikes with an automated slow-path fallback (route to smaller model or rate limit).

bella-cs: Support training: we need a 1-page cheat sheet for CS showing expected customer messages and suggested responses, plus links to incident tracker and billing replay. I'll produce and pair with an internal office hours session.

lee: Timeline and owners:
- tara: SLA doc + severity mapping + customer-facing snippet (EOD Tue)
- michael: dashboards + anomaly detector config (Wed)
- bella-cs: CS cheat sheet + email templates + office hours (Thu)
- finance-bot / finance: invoice preview + audit retention confirmation (Thu)
- lee: coordinate dry-run incident the day before GA and finalize rollback automation (Fri)

michael: For the dry-run, can we simulate quota breaches and billing replay to exercise runbooks? I can script an end-to-end test harness.

tara: Yes, include a scripted postmortem template so we can capture gaps.

eng-oncall-bot: scheduled: GA-dryrun-simulation at 1767210000.

lee: Final decisions from this thread: SLA targets set (99.95% monthly, latencies as above), rollback thresholds defined, invoice preview requirement locked, CS escalation steps approved, and owners assigned. We'll meet Fri 09:00 PT for the dry-run. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
